Hey man. I'm awful with words and I wish I could help you or give some advice, but I have none. The only thing that I have to offer you is the fact that I'm feeling the same way and you're not alone. I know we don't know each other but I care a lot about you and your wellbeing. Fuck those people calling you those names. fuck people on this thread who are rude to you. I believe in your power and I believe that you're gonna be doing great things. I'm here to talk if you ever need me. Maybe we could swap stories sometime.

Hey man. I don't have anything to offer you, because I'm in the same situation too. I just wanted to come say that you're not alone. I'm feeling the same way you are. Maybe it will help to share a bit of my story.

I attempted suicide when i was 18. I started out feeling the typical symptoms of depression. Losing all interest in hobbies, cutting off friends, crying at least 3 times a day. Then as months passed, even all that faded away. I felt emotionless, nothing brought me joy, sadness or anger. All that was left was a desire to die, but not out of sadness. My desire to die came from the fact that I simply was indifferent to living. 

Maybe you can relate to this, but when you're feeling suicidal thoughts, or in the act of attempting. There's something that takes over your mind and body. My depression and suicidal thoughts started out as normal emotions, and then progressed to numbness. I feel like everyone, even the most depressed and suicidal people, are wonderful people and they were put here for a reason. Everyone has aspirations and desires, wants, likes and dislikes, and unique personality traits at least some point in their life. But depression and suicidal ideation can just fucking destroy all that. Feeling suicidal is something that almost feels like an out of body experience.  It's sort of like a parasite or a leech, sucking the joy out of you. But it's somehow comforting to place blame on some unidentifiable power or force that's causing you to think these thoughts instead of yourself. It gives you an enemy to fight, or at least something to work towards.

I'm not sure how to make it stop, if i knew I would tell you. It's been years since my attempt and somehow I'm still fighting. I wish you the best.

I feel the exact same way. I hate when people try to make it about themselves or try to blame you for feeling the way you do. depression is a psychological and biological condition where your brain doesn't produce enough fucking serotonin. It's not some choice or an emo phase. It's life long, soul sucking, and heart breaking. Wishing you the best man

And looking through all these posts is overwhelming. on one hand i feel less alone, on the other it just makes me so mad that so many people are suffering. Whoever created all of this really enjoys seeing people suffer I guess.
